about: Generated by elevator_alpha_vectors.mjs from elevator.html's model (Flight, TailAir and Elevator); checked by it and, in C++, by workbench_tests.cpp (elevator.hpp, and flight.hpp's tail_side for the panels). Do not edit by hand.

units.alpha_deg: the tail's angle as X-Plane reports it, degrees, air from below positive; taken to exclude the elevator's own deflection
units.stalled: the stalled share of the tail's q*area, 0..1
units.alpha_slope_per_rad: Ch_alpha, the float slope; positive floats the trailing edge up with a positive angle
units.stall_factor: the share of the air's moments a stalled tail keeps
units.hinge_slope_per_rad: Ch_delta: the figures' value except where a case sets it
units.alpha_used_deg: after the 2.5 Pa gate and the ±30° clamp
units.reversed: air from behind, beyond ±90° with air over the gate: the deflection's moment turns over (k_rev of it), so the elevator runs to a stop; alpha_used_deg is the angle against the reversed stream
units.k_rev: the share of the deflection's moment that turns over with air from behind
units.surface: the page's tail stall along the travel, {tau, stall deg, width deg}: stalled share ramps from 0 to 1 as |angle + tau*deflection| passes stall over width; null: only X-Plane's share
units.stalled_at: the stalled share at each of force_at_counts
units.solutions: the page's solve at x0 drive counts (null: from trim, at the rest), 222 units per lb, the case's pressure as written: the rest reached from x0 (counts), the stiffness at that rest (lb per inch of yoke), the drive's ceiling, strength, centre and bias, the model's and the drive's force at x0 (lb forward positive), the model's secant and the flags
units.float_lb: the float at the grip, lb forward positive
units.rest_deg: the elevator at the model's rest, trailing edge down positive
units.rest_counts: the rest in drive counts, 12000 at either stop, forward positive, unrounded
units.force_lb: the model at the counts in force_at_counts, lb forward positive
units.chain: the page's flight chain: flight {kt, throttle, n asked, ground, pitchRate deg/s beyond a steady pull, tailwind kt}; the model's state is the reached load factor, the reported angle, unbalance 30 in·lb, the default figures and the surface stall
units.panels: [speed m/s, area m², angle deg, stall flag] per element of wings 8 and 9, tips excluded; null is a non-finite value; a case's tail_pa, alpha_deg and stalled are null when the read is empty
units.sweeps: the tail's angle from from_deg to to_deg in sweep.step_deg steps at tail_pa, the page's figures and surface stall, trim neutral, 1 g, unbalance 30 in·lb: the rest (counts), the stiffness at the rest and the force at sweep.at_counts at each step; no step may move the rest more than sweep.rest_counts nor the stiffness or a force more than sweep.per_pa times tail_pa
